pr.title: fix(deps): repair dependabot uv resolver metadata
pr.body:
## Problem
The post-merge Dependabot uv security-update workflow on main fails while resolving a security update group that includes LiteLLM, MCP, FastMCP, Semgrep, PyJWT, ecdsa, and Mako. The log shows an unsatisfiable split around newer LiteLLM, Semgrep, and MCP selection.

## Fix
Align root package Python support metadata with advertised classifiers and raise the MCP service floor to the Semgrep-compatible patched MCP release.

## Test Plan
- Validate Task Packet JSON and schema.
- Check the uv lock with uv 0.11.8, matching the Dependabot updater version observed in logs.
- Dry-run the Dependabot-relevant package update set with uv 0.11.8.
- Run git diff --check and pre-commit on changed files.

steps.task: Inspect the GitHub Dependabot failure, root package metadata, and uv lock resolver markers.
requirements: Identify whether the failure is a repo CI gate or Dependabot updater failure.
Inspect root pyproject dependencies and Python support metadata.
Use uv 0.11.8 for resolver simulation because Dependabot reported that updater version.

steps.task: Update only the root dependency metadata and lockfile required to unblock Dependabot uv resolution.
requirements: Keep Python support bounded to the versions advertised by classifiers.
Raise MCP service dependency to the compatible patched release required by current Semgrep.
Regenerate only lockfile changes implied by pyproject metadata.
validation: uv tool run --from uv==0.11.8 uv lock --check
uv tool run --from uv==0.11.8 uv lock --dry-run -P litellm -P Mako -P PyJWT -P ecdsa -P fastmcp -P mcp -P semgrep

steps.task: Validate packet, dependency metadata, proof, diff scope, and pre-commit before opening the PR.
requirements: Record validation exit codes in proof.
Inspect git status and diff scope before staging.
Do not claim GitHub Dependabot is fixed until the repair PR lands and the workflow is observed.
